faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Calicut?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Calicut is 18th August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 44,400.

faq.question: Q3. What are the minimum educational qualifications required?
faq.answer: Candidates must be GATE/ CSIR-UGC-NET qualified and possess an M. Tech / M. Sc. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Analytics, Signal Processing, or allied programs.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of applications followed by a hybrid interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this position?
faq.answer: The application process is via email. Candidates need to send their complete application to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow post at NIT Calicut.

faq.question: Q8. Are there any desirable qualifications for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: Yes, prior experience in funded research projects and publications, especially in AI/NLP/Speech Processing domains, are considered desirable.

faq.question: Q9. What is the location of the job?
faq.answer: The job is located at the National Institute of Technology Calicut in Calicut, Kerala.

faq.question: Q10. What is the nature of the employment for this post?
faq.answer: The position of Junior Research Fellow is on a contractual basis.
